spans.s:
(ञ) धुञ् r. 7th cl. (धुनोति धुनुते)
To shake, to agitate: see धू.

f. (धुः)
Shaking, trembling.
E.
धु to shake, क्विप् aff.

(ञ) धूञ् r. 5th cl. (धूनोति धूनुते) r. 6th cl. (धूवति) r. 9th cl. (धुनाति धुनीते) r. 1st and 10th cls. (धवति-ते धावयति-ते or धूनयति)
To shake or agitate, to make tremble.
With अव prefixed,
1 To abandon, to quit.
2 To perceive.
With निर्,
1 To destroy.
2 To go or move.
With वि,
To make tremble or agitate.
